title: Choose the landing page structure
question: A fresh hand. The colours, type and crop marks stay; pick how the page is built.

options.label: Price board
options.thesis: The page opens on the package board a shop already has on its wall, and picking a package builds its sheet.
options.viewport: Headline across the top; the board of packages A to D and whole-sheet fills at left; the chosen package's real 4R sheet at right; Open Sylvi under the board.
options.risk: Leads with packages, so first-time visitors must still see in one glance that Sylvi crops the face for them.

raised.raise: One idea per section, set off-centre, never two claims side by side.
Before a package is picked, the sheet waits empty with its crop marks, an invitation to choose.

options.label: A day at the counter
options.thesis: One shop day from opening to closing, each walk-in customer pinned at their time with the sheet Sylvi made them.
options.viewport: Headline at left; a time ruler from 8 AM to 6 PM across the top; three customers hung from it with their request and finished sheet.
options.risk: Sideways scrolling is slower to skim; it needs a plain vertical layout on phones.

options.label: Word vs Sylvi
options.thesis: The same order made two ways, split down the middle by a handle you drag.
options.viewport: Headline over a full-width split: a crooked Word page at left, the clean Sylvi sheet at right, a magenta handle between them.
options.risk: Leaning on the competitor can read as mockery; the Word side must look like real shop work, not a strawman.
